item.title: Iran's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei 'misfunctioning,' not controlling regime: sources
item.summary: Iran's new Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, took power after his father Ali Khamenei was killed in an Israeli strike, but Israeli intelligence says he lacks control over the regime.

item.title: GOP blocks Booker-led push to curb Trump's military authority in Iran
item.summary: Senate Democrats plan multiple war powers resolutions to challenge President Trump's Iran military operations in a bid to force public testimony from top administration officials.

item.title: Iran’s hidden mountain nuclear site raises urgent threat, must be ‘neutralized': reports
item.summary: Andrea Stricker warns the U.S. must neutralize Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site and secure uranium stockpiles before ending combat operations.

item.title: California Democrats distance themselves from famed pro-union activist after bombshell report
item.summary: Sexual abuse allegations against Cesar Chavez prompted several California leaders including Gov. Gavin Newsom to distance themselves from the labor activist.

item.title: After Michigan attack, Jewish teens show antisemitism won’t define them
item.summary: After Oct. 7, Jewish youth organizations shifted from confronting antisemitism to strengthening Jewish identity through community and tradition.

item.title: Former counterterrorism chief Joe Kent under FBI investigation for alleged classified leaks
item.summary: FBI investigating former counterterror chief Joe Kent over alleged classified leak, sources tell Fox News Digital, with probe predating his abrupt resignation.

item.title: Millionaire developer found dead in ritzy beach home; bizarrely dressed suspect arrested after standoff
item.summary: A millionaire developer, 92, was found dead in a Southern California beach home after a bizarrely dressed suspect surrendered after an hours-long SWAT standoff, authorities say.

item.title: Uma Thurman reveals why she never lived in Los Angeles
item.summary: "Kill Bill" star Uma Thurman chose family over Hollywood proximity, admitting that staying in New York prevented industry integration she now wishes she'd had.

item.title: LSU star Flau’jae Johnson carries bearded dragon into final NCAA Tournament run of college career
item.summary: Flau’jae Johnson will take the floor in the NCAA Tournament for the final time Friday. Johnson, a college basketball national champion, reflected on her four-year career at LSU.

item.title: Immigration judge orders deportation of NYC Council employee after ICE arrest; city leaders push back
item.summary: An NYC Council employee is facing deportation despite officials claiming legal work authorization. An Immigration judge ordered the employee's removal amid the controversy.
